description: What done means for every implementation leaf (DR-0003 decision P8). From S2, each leaf-dag.json node's dod lists the items it meets, and each program.mjs rule names the items it enforces.
changePolicy: Adding an item or tightening one is additive and raises revision. Dropping or loosening one needs the owner's approval in a superseding DR-0003 revision.

items.title: Account-authorized
items.rule: Every command, read, relation, source, revision, search result, projection, job, export, and share the leaf adds derives its account on the server and authorizes it. A client never chooses or overrides ownership, and another account's record reads as not found.
items.appliesTo: Every leaf that adds or changes a command, read, store, job, or share.

checkedBy.check: authorization matrix coverage for each command and read

items.title: Expected version
items.rule: Every mutating command carries the aggregate versions it read and returns a typed conflict result when one moved, never a silent overwrite.
items.appliesTo: Every leaf that adds or changes a mutating command.

checkedBy.check: expected-version and conflict result contract tests

items.title: Idempotent
items.rule: Every mutating command carries a command id; a replay returns the stored result and writes nothing new.
items.appliesTo: Every leaf that adds or changes a mutating command.

items.title: Revisioned and audited
items.rule: An accepted change commits its records, change set, revision, Audit Entry, and outbox entry in one transaction; its Domain Event goes out after that commit.
items.appliesTo: Every leaf that adds or changes a mutating command.

checkedBy.check: change set, revision, and Audit Entry atomicity

items.title: One writable authority
items.rule: Each concept the leaf touches has one writable authority at every revision, named in DR-0002; compatibility adapters read, shadow, or compare and never write.
items.appliesTo: Every leaf that writes a store or moves an authority.

checkedBy.check: program.mjs: a context in two boundedContext lists (S2)

items.title: Correlation and redaction
items.rule: Commands, events, and logs carry causation and correlation ids. Logs, traces, and metrics hold metadata and opaque ids only, as each field's privacy class allows.
items.appliesTo: Every leaf that adds a command, event, job, log, trace, or metric.

checkedBy.check: log, trace, and metric redaction checks

items.title: Design contract and review
items.rule: A surface leaf follows rounds-review DESIGN.md and gets a design review on its PR before merge.
items.appliesTo: Every leaf that adds or changes a screen, dialog, or route.

checkedBy.check: browser, accessibility, responsive, and visual tests
